locations.name: Snakehead, the holy cave
locations.lighting: Before dawn: one amber lamp kept lit at the old bench as a votive, hard falloff into black (bible Part VI, Dr. Tox section 9, The bunker), and a cold pale light off the water in the Ghost's tank; by day a shaft of grey light from the breach; along the corridor, oil lamps on the scaffold.

locations.name: The Glass Mountains
locations.lighting: Foot: overcast plain daylight on dust, the towers' glass catching it high up; the crown: dawn low and gold through broken glass, then night with oil lamps under the bell frame and the breathing city glowing pale blue-white below.
